question: After observing the logged row at t, predict logged AC power at t+1 second, without the future setpoint
scope: retrospective log-time conditional forecast; not verified live availability, instruction receipt latency, causal dynamics or capacity
clock: publisher-declared UTC; no lag search or shifted signals
availability_assumption: row t and previous row are assumed jointly available after logging t; actual device/publication/network delay unknown
qualification: finite complete native t-1,t inputs and unflagged interpolation; paired evaluation additionally needs a finite unflagged target at t+1; all three times within one frozen partition
keep: all powers/directions/current modes including stop/silent/wait/unknown; future setpoint and mode changes retained; no SOC, DC, future-mode or prediction-error selection
split_rationale: fixed chronological 60/20/20 allocation, not chosen by forecast error; purge cross-partition prefix/target rows, no random seconds
primary_evaluation_subset: Mode_PQ=1 at origin t only; future mode unconstrained
reporting: full coverage plus current-mode/PQ results; MAE kW and signed bias; primary PQ MAE equal-weighted over UTC origin dates with PQ samples; per-date paired deltas, not independent-seconds confidence intervals
existing_test_use: all April raw records already quality-audited; this is retrospective chronological evaluation, not fresh blind testing
not_in_model: source timestamp as an encoded predictor
source_edits: none; no filling, smoothing, clipping powers, SOC correction or time shifts
protocol_freeze: before any new forecast fitting or forecast-error evaluation; no claim that quality inspection was blind
